courses.title: How to Read & Write Proofs
courses.blurb: Logic, sets, induction, proof patterns. The on-ramp to analysis and topology.

courses.title: Calculus
courses.blurb: Single + multivariable, through vector calculus.

courses.title: Linear Algebra
courses.blurb: Through spectral theorem, SVD, and inner-product spaces.

courses.title: Differential Equations
courses.blurb: ODEs, linear systems, phase portraits, intro PDEs.

courses.title: Probability & Statistics
courses.blurb: Distributions, expectation, LLN/CLT, Bayes, basic inference.

courses.title: Newtonian Mechanics
courses.blurb: Kinematics through rotation, oscillations, central forces.

courses.title: Electromagnetism
courses.blurb: Maxwell's equations and what they mean.

courses.title: Game Theory
courses.blurb: Normal/extensive form, Nash, mixed strategies, repeated games.

courses.title: Mathematical Microeconomics
courses.blurb: Consumer/producer theory, Lagrangians, comparative statics.

courses.title: Real Analysis
courses.blurb: Sequences, limits, continuity, integration, uniform convergence — with proofs.

courses.title: Complex Analysis
courses.blurb: Holomorphy, Cauchy's theorem, residues, conformal maps.

courses.title: Topology
courses.blurb: Point-set core plus a taste of the fundamental group.

courses.title: Probability Theory
courses.blurb: Measure-theoretic-lite: sigma-algebras, convergence, conditional expectation, martingales.

courses.title: Analytical Mechanics
courses.blurb: Calculus of variations, Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, Noether. The gateway to QM.

courses.title: Grad Game Theory
courses.blurb: Optimization & fixed points, existence proofs, Bayesian games, mechanism design, folk theorems.

courses.title: Grad Microeconomics
courses.blurb: Optimization module, choice axioms, general equilibrium, welfare theorems, information economics.

courses.title: Quantum Mechanics
courses.blurb: State vectors, operators, Schrödinger equation, spin, entanglement, perturbation theory.

courses.title: Statistical Mechanics
courses.blurb: Ensembles, entropy, partition functions, phase transitions.

courses.title: Relativity (SR + GR)
courses.blurb: SR from postulates, classical field theory (EM as the worked example), a differential-geometry interlude, then Einstein's equations, black holes, and cosmology.

courses.title: Astrophysics
courses.blurb: Stellar structure, compact objects, galaxies, cosmology. The capstone.

courses.title: Partial Differential Equations
courses.blurb: Heat/wave/Laplace, separation of variables, Fourier & Green's functions, Sturm-Liouville. The workhorse for QM, EM, and GR.

courses.title: Functional Analysis
courses.blurb: Banach/Hilbert spaces, bounded & unbounded operators, the spectral theorem. The rigorous home of quantum mechanics.

courses.title: Differential Geometry
courses.blurb: Manifolds, tensors, differential forms, connections, curvature. The honest foundation for GR and gauge theory.

courses.title: Abstract Algebra
courses.blurb: Groups, rings, fields, quotients, homomorphisms. Foundation for representation theory and coding.

courses.title: Dynamical Systems & Chaos
courses.blurb: Flows, stability, bifurcations, chaos, strange attractors, routes to chaos via maps.

courses.title: Stochastic Calculus
courses.blurb: Brownian motion, the Ito integral & lemma, SDEs, Girsanov, Feynman-Kac. The engine for mathematical finance.

courses.title: Information Theory
courses.blurb: Entropy, mutual information, source & channel coding, max-entropy. Bridges stat-mech, ML, and information economics.

courses.title: Group & Representation Theory
courses.blurb: Representations, characters, Lie groups/algebras. SU(2)/SO(3) as angular momentum & spin; the language of gauge symmetry.

courses.title: Quantum Field Theory
courses.blurb: Canonical quantization, Feynman diagrams, QED, path integrals, renormalization. The physics summit.

courses.title: Fluid Dynamics
courses.blurb: Euler & Navier-Stokes, vorticity, potential flow, viscosity, waves, instability & turbulence.

courses.title: Grad Macroeconomics
courses.blurb: Recursive methods, growth, OLG, RBC/DSGE, consumption/investment, asset pricing, policy. The pair to grad-micro.

courses.title: Econometrics
courses.blurb: OLS geometry, inference, identification, IV, panel & diff-in-diff, causal inference, MLE/GMM.

courses.title: Mathematical Finance
courses.blurb: No-arbitrage & risk-neutral pricing, Black-Scholes, portfolio theory/SDF, term structure.

courses.title: Political Economy & Social Choice
courses.blurb: Social choice, voting & elections, collective action, political agency, coalitions & redistribution.

courses.title: Statistical Learning Theory
courses.blurb: Bias-variance, regularization, VC/PAC generalization, kernels/SVM, trees/boosting, neural nets, unsupervised.

courses.title: Political Philosophy
courses.blurb: Authority, justice (Rawls/Nozick), liberty, equality, democracy. The first course in a humanities track; normative companion to political-economy.

courses.title: Arithmetic & Number Sense
courses.blurb: Fractions, ratios, percents, estimation, mental math. The floor below algebra.

courses.title: Algebra I & II
courses.blurb: Equations, factoring, functions, exponents & logs. The language everything downstream is written in.

courses.title: Euclidean Geometry
courses.blurb: Congruence, similarity, circles, area — proof-based. The classic first taste of rigor.

courses.title: Trigonometry
courses.blurb: Unit circle, identities, triangle-solving, waves. The bridge from geometry to calculus.

courses.title: Precalculus
courses.blurb: Functions, polynomials, conics, sequences, limits-at-the-door. Assembles the toolkit calculus assumes.

courses.title: Discrete Math for Beginners
courses.blurb: Counting, logic, sets, basic proof. The gentle on-ramp to proofs-primer and CS.

courses.title: Discrete Mathematics
courses.blurb: Logic, sets, combinatorics, recurrences, and graphs — the mathematics of the discrete, and the backbone of CS.

courses.title: Number Theory
courses.blurb: Primes, congruences, Diophantine equations, quadratic reciprocity, and the arithmetic behind RSA.

courses.title: Graph Theory
courses.blurb: Connectivity, trees, matchings, coloring, planarity, flows, and a taste of spectral graph theory.

courses.title: Enumerative & Algebraic Combinatorics
courses.blurb: Bijections, generating functions, inclusion-exclusion, permutations & partitions, and Ramsey theory.

courses.title: Numerical Analysis
courses.blurb: Floating point, root-finding, interpolation, quadrature, linear solvers, and ODE integrators — with error & stability.

courses.title: Convex Optimization
courses.blurb: Convex sets & functions, duality, KKT conditions, and gradient/Newton/interior-point methods.

courses.title: Fourier & Harmonic Analysis
courses.blurb: Fourier series & transforms, convergence, Parseval, distributions, and applications to signals and PDEs.

courses.title: Logic & Set Theory
courses.blurb: Propositional & first-order logic, soundness & completeness, ZFC, ordinals & cardinals, and a taste of Godel.

courses.title: Waves & Optics
courses.blurb: Oscillations, the wave equation, interference, diffraction, polarization, and geometric & physical optics.

courses.title: Classical Thermodynamics
courses.blurb: The four laws, heat engines, entropy, and thermodynamic potentials — before the statistical picture.

courses.title: Mathematical Methods for Physics
courses.blurb: The physicist toolbox: vector calculus, special functions, complex methods, tensors, and Greens functions.

courses.title: Computational Physics
courses.blurb: Numerical integration of ODEs/PDEs, Monte Carlo, molecular dynamics, and simulating physical systems.

courses.title: Nuclear & Particle Physics
courses.blurb: Nuclear structure & decay, scattering, the particle zoo, symmetries, and the Standard Model.

courses.title: Condensed Matter / Solid State
courses.blurb: Crystal lattices, band structure, phonons, semiconductors, magnetism, and superconductivity.

courses.title: Plasma Physics
courses.blurb: Single-particle motion, kinetic theory, MHD, and waves & instabilities — the bridge to fusion.

courses.title: Biophysics
courses.blurb: The statistical physics of life: random walks, polymers, membranes, molecular motors, and reaction kinetics.

courses.title: Quantum Optics & Photonics
courses.blurb: Quantized light, coherence, cavity QED, single photons, and the optics behind lasers.

courses.title: Statics
courses.blurb: Forces, moments, equilibrium, trusses & frames, friction, centroids — the engineering foundation for structures.

courses.title: Dynamics
courses.blurb: Kinematics & kinetics of particles and rigid bodies, work-energy, impulse-momentum, and vibrations.

courses.title: Mechanics of Materials
courses.blurb: Stress & strain, axial/torsion/bending, beam deflection, buckling, and failure criteria.

courses.title: Engineering Thermodynamics
courses.blurb: Properties, the first & second law for open systems, power & refrigeration cycles.

courses.title: Heat Transfer
courses.blurb: Conduction, convection, radiation, heat exchangers, and transient conduction.

courses.title: Control Systems
courses.blurb: Feedback, transfer functions, root locus, Bode plots, PID, and state-space control.

courses.title: Signals & Systems
courses.blurb: LTI systems, convolution, the Fourier/Laplace/z-transforms, sampling, and filtering.

courses.title: Intro to Nuclear Engineering & Radiation
courses.blurb: Nuclear reactions & cross-sections, fission, ionizing radiation, and dose — the foundations of the field.

courses.title: Reactor Physics & Neutron Transport
courses.blurb: Neutron diffusion & transport, criticality, the six-factor formula, and reactor kinetics.

courses.title: Reactor Thermal-Hydraulics
courses.blurb: Core heat removal, single- & two-phase flow, boiling, and thermal safety margins.

courses.title: Nuclear Materials
courses.blurb: Radiation damage, fuels & cladding, and material behavior under irradiation.

courses.title: Radiation Detection & Shielding
courses.blurb: Radiation interactions with matter, detectors, dosimetry, and shielding & attenuation.

courses.title: Fusion & Plasma Engineering
courses.blurb: Magnetic & inertial confinement, tokamaks, the Lawson criterion, and the path to fusion power.

courses.title: Nuclear Fuel Cycle & Policy
courses.blurb: Mining to waste: enrichment, fuel fabrication, reprocessing, waste, and proliferation & policy.

courses.title: Materials Science & Engineering
courses.blurb: Structure-property relationships: crystals, defects, phase diagrams, mechanical & electronic properties.

courses.title: Circuit Analysis
courses.blurb: Kirchhoff's laws, nodal/mesh analysis, RLC transients, phasors, and AC power.

courses.title: Electronics & Semiconductors
courses.blurb: Diodes, BJTs, MOSFETs, amplifiers, op-amps, and digital-gate basics.

courses.title: Digital Logic Design
courses.blurb: Boolean algebra, combinational & sequential logic, finite-state machines, and datapaths.

courses.title: Communication Systems
courses.blurb: Modulation (AM/FM/digital), noise, matched filters, and channel capacity.

courses.title: Power Systems
courses.blurb: Three-phase power, transformers, transmission lines, load flow, and grid stability.

courses.title: Semiconductor Devices
courses.blurb: Band theory applied: carrier transport, p-n junctions, BJTs, MOSFETs, and photodevices.

courses.title: Structural Analysis
courses.blurb: Trusses, frames, beams, deflections, indeterminate structures, and influence lines.

courses.title: Aerodynamics
courses.blurb: Airfoils, lift & drag, potential flow, boundary layers, and compressible/supersonic flow.

courses.title: Astrodynamics
courses.blurb: Two-body orbits, Kepler's laws, orbital maneuvers, transfers, and rendezvous.

courses.title: Propulsion
courses.blurb: Thermodynamic cycles, jet & rocket engines, nozzles, and the rocket equation.

courses.title: Robotics & Kinematics
courses.blurb: Forward/inverse kinematics, manipulator dynamics, trajectory planning, and feedback control.

courses.title: Transport Phenomena
courses.blurb: Unified momentum, heat, and mass transfer — the chemical-engineering keystone.

courses.title: Chemical Reaction Engineering
courses.blurb: Reaction kinetics, batch/CSTR/PFR reactor design, catalysis, and selectivity.

courses.title: Operations Research
courses.blurb: Linear & integer programming, network flows, queueing theory, and scheduling.

courses.title: Programming & Data Structures
courses.blurb: Programming fundamentals plus the core data structures: lists, stacks, trees, hashing, graphs — with Big-O.

courses.title: Algorithms
courses.blurb: Divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, greedy methods, graph algorithms, and complexity analysis.

courses.title: Automata & Computability
courses.blurb: Regular & context-free languages, automata, Turing machines, decidability, and reductions.

courses.title: Complexity Theory
courses.blurb: P vs NP, NP-completeness & reductions, space complexity, and randomized & approximation classes.

courses.title: Computer Architecture
courses.blurb: From logic gates to CPUs: instruction sets, pipelining, caches, and the memory hierarchy.

courses.title: Operating Systems
courses.blurb: Processes & threads, scheduling, virtual memory, file systems, and concurrency.

courses.title: Networking
courses.blurb: The TCP/IP stack, routing, reliable transport, congestion control, and security basics.

courses.title: Database Systems
courses.blurb: The relational model, SQL, normalization, indexing, transactions, and query processing.

courses.title: Programming Languages & Compilers
courses.blurb: Lexing & parsing, type systems, semantics, the lambda calculus, and code generation.

courses.title: Cryptography
courses.blurb: One-way functions, symmetric & public-key crypto (AES/RSA/ECC), hashing, protocols, and zero-knowledge.

courses.title: Distributed Systems
courses.blurb: Time & consistency, replication, consensus (Paxos/Raft), the CAP theorem, and fault tolerance.

courses.title: Machine Learning
courses.blurb: Regression, SVMs, trees, clustering, and model selection — the applied companion to statistical-learning.

courses.title: Deep Learning
courses.blurb: Neural networks, backpropagation, CNNs, RNNs, transformers, and training at scale.

courses.title: Reinforcement Learning
courses.blurb: MDPs, dynamic programming, TD & Q-learning, policy gradients, and deep RL.

courses.title: Computer Graphics
courses.blurb: Rasterization, ray tracing, transformations, shading, and the linear algebra of rendering.

courses.title: Quantum Computing
courses.blurb: Qubits, gates & circuits, teleportation, and the Deutsch-Jozsa, Grover, and Shor algorithms.

courses.title: General Chemistry
courses.blurb: Atoms, stoichiometry, bonding, thermochemistry, equilibrium, acids & bases, and redox.

courses.title: Organic Chemistry I & II
courses.blurb: Structure & bonding, functional groups, reaction mechanisms, stereochemistry, and synthesis.

courses.title: Physical Chemistry
courses.blurb: Chemical thermodynamics, kinetics, and quantum chemistry — chemistry from physical first principles.

courses.title: Quantum Chemistry
courses.blurb: Molecular-orbital theory, the variational & Hartree-Fock methods, DFT, and computational chemistry.

courses.title: Inorganic Chemistry
courses.blurb: Periodic trends, coordination complexes, crystal-field theory, symmetry, and organometallics.

courses.title: Analytical & Instrumental Chemistry
courses.blurb: Quantitative analysis, equilibria, chromatography, spectroscopy, and mass spectrometry.

courses.title: Biochemistry
courses.blurb: Proteins & enzymes, metabolism, nucleic acids, and bioenergetics.

courses.title: Electrochemistry
courses.blurb: Redox thermodynamics, the Nernst equation, electrode kinetics, batteries, fuel cells, and corrosion.

courses.title: Polymer & Materials Chemistry
courses.blurb: Polymerization, molecular weight, chain conformations, the glass transition, and self-assembly.

courses.title: Geology
courses.blurb: Minerals & rocks, plate tectonics, the rock cycle, geologic time, and Earth's structure.

courses.title: Atmospheric Science
courses.blurb: Atmospheric thermodynamics, moisture & stability, circulation, and weather systems.

courses.title: Geophysics
courses.blurb: Seismology, gravity & magnetics, heat flow, and imaging Earth's interior.

courses.title: Climate Physics
courses.blurb: Radiative balance, the greenhouse effect, feedbacks, the carbon cycle, and climate models.

courses.title: Physical Oceanography
courses.blurb: Ocean circulation, waves, tides, water masses, and the ocean's role in climate.

courses.title: Planetary Science
courses.blurb: Planet formation, interiors, atmospheres, surfaces, and habitability.

courses.title: Cosmology
courses.blurb: The expanding universe, the FLRW model & ΛCDM, the CMB, nucleosynthesis, inflation, and structure formation.

courses.title: General Biology
courses.blurb: Cells, energy & metabolism, genetics, evolution, and the organization of life.

courses.title: Molecular & Cell Biology
courses.blurb: Biomolecules, DNA to RNA to protein, membranes, organelles, and cell signaling.

courses.title: Genetics
courses.blurb: Mendelian & molecular genetics, linkage & mapping, mutation, and population genetics.

courses.title: Evolution & Ecology
courses.blurb: Natural selection, drift, speciation, population dynamics, and community ecology.

courses.title: Human Physiology
courses.blurb: Organ systems, homeostasis, nerve & muscle, circulation, and feedback control.

courses.title: Neuroscience
courses.blurb: Neurons & action potentials, synapses, neural circuits, sensory systems, and plasticity.

courses.title: Computational Biology
courses.blurb: Sequence alignment, phylogenetics, genomics, and modeling biological data.

courses.title: Systems Biology
courses.blurb: Gene-regulatory & metabolic networks, dynamics, feedback, and modeling the cell.

courses.title: Immunology
courses.blurb: Innate & adaptive immunity, antibodies, T & B cells, and the logic of immune defense.

courses.title: Measure Theory
courses.blurb: σ-algebras, Lebesgue measure & integration, the convergence theorems, and Lᵖ spaces.

courses.title: Algebraic Topology
courses.blurb: Homotopy, the fundamental group, covering spaces, and homology — the tools past π₁.

courses.title: Algebraic Geometry
courses.blurb: Affine & projective varieties, the Nullstellensatz, sheaves, and a first look at schemes.

courses.title: Category Theory
courses.blurb: Categories, functors, natural transformations, universal properties, limits, and adjunctions.
